card.name: Random characters inside web link codes
card.fires_on: Short chunks of random letters and digits inside YouTube IDs, shortened links and password or hash strings. It fires partway through the code, not on ordinary words.

modes.label: Video and short-link IDs
modes.description: Letter pairs in the middle of YouTube or shortened URL codes.

modes.label: Other random strings
modes.description: Pieces of hashes, encrypted passwords or directory codes.
modes.example: User username added with password encrypted to l4jrdAL9<<MH>>0K.

card.plain: It lights up on the jumbled letters in the middle of web addresses and codes, where the text is random.
